parameters.query: SELECT pc.status, pc.is_applicable, cd.dod_score_value, cd.nist_id, cd.far_above_phase FROM program_controls pc JOIN control_definitions cd ON pc.control_definition_id = cd.id WHERE pc.program_id = '{{ $json.body.program_id }}'::uuid AND cd.is_objective = false

UPDATE programs SET sprs_score={{ $json.sprs_score }}::integer, far_above_score={{ $json.far_above_score }}::integer, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id='{{ $json.program_id }}'::uuid RETURNING sprs_score::text, far_above_score::text
